1.

God has triumphed through Christ Jesus, The help placed in a Helper, God has triumphed over human hearts With His wondrous power of love. God has triumphed, soon the whole earth Shall be covered with His glory, And His glory’s praise shall resound aloud Through eternity’s eternities.

2.

God has triumphed, eternal is His victory, Eternal as His love is, And through Christ He has proclaimed to us That our sweet resting place is there. God loves us; nothing of all creation Can separate us from this love. However enemies may rage around us, God has triumphed in His “Counsel’s Man.”
